evidence: Modifies block and undo file storage (src/node/blockstorage.cpp) to rewrite blk*.dat and rev*.dat under new XOR keys.
rationale: Adds crash-safe, resumable block file reobfuscation to resolve a long-standing operational pain point. As described, 'Nodes that synced before v28 may store block and undo files effectively unobfuscated... leaving them susceptible to antivirus scanners misidentifying block data', requiring a complete resync without this tool; however, it is an optional offline migration that is reasonably deferrable.
